question: How does the parcel delivery service work?
answer: Our parcel delivery service makes shipping simple and convenient. You can book a delivery, provide the pickup and delivery details, and track your parcel in real-time until it reaches its destination.

question: How can I track my parcel?
answer: After your parcel is booked, you will receive a tracking ID. Use this tracking ID to check the current location and delivery status of your parcel at any time.

question: How long does delivery usually take?
answer: Delivery time depends on the destination and delivery type. Most local deliveries are completed within the estimated delivery time shown during the booking process.

question: Is my parcel safe during delivery?
answer: Yes. We carefully handle parcels throughout the delivery process and follow proper safety procedures to ensure your package reaches its destination securely.

question: Can I cancel my delivery after booking?
answer: Yes, you may be able to cancel a delivery depending on its current status. Please contact our support team as soon as possible for assistance.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can contact our customer support team through the support center. Our team is available to help you with delivery, tracking, booking, and other questions.
